description: React component for a source code viewer with sidebar stack trace, external linking, and syntax highlighting, used within a trace viewer application.

methods.name: useSources
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages loading and highlighting source code based on current trace stack frame and fallback location.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Asynchronously computes SHA-1 hash of a given string, used for caching source files.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Utility function extracting filename from a full path.
